rentalLicensing.summary: Ann Arbor requires a Certificate of Compliance before a dwelling or rooming unit may be leased, issued through the city's rental housing registration and inspection program.

faq.q: Does Ann Arbor require a rental license for a long-term rental?
faq.a: Yes. The city requires a Certificate of Compliance before an owner may lease a dwelling or rooming unit, under its rental housing registration and inspection program.

faq.q: How often does Ann Arbor inspect registered rental units?
faq.a: The city's Rental Housing office inspects registered rental units every 30 months.

faq.q: What is Fulton County's property tax millage rate?
faq.a: Fulton County held its general fund millage rate at 8.87 mills for 2025, equal to 0.887% of assessed value, according to the county. That covers only the county's general fund portion; total property tax bills also include city and school district millage.

sources.title: Fulton County, Fulton Holds Millage Rate at 8.87 Mills for 2025
